recorded_by: the synthesis lane, from five read-only reports of 2026-10-02 (the rail, the projection tools, the shelf and gate, R2 and the shipments, the guards), revised the same day on three reviews; every value names where it was read
what_this_is: the toggle push queue: every delivery of Moses's this lane knows about, what it feeds on the rail, where it sits on R2, which tool projects it, what it waits on, and where the owner's ruling is owed. Read by tools/push-toggles-v1.mjs, which proposes and prints and never chooses, and which carries this file's rule id as a constant and faults the file when the two differ. The runbook is the file named under runbook below.
report: build/toggle-push-report-<stamp>.md — written by the operator as the loop runs, never by the driver; what a receipt says is copied into it and never patched; build/ is scratch, so the report is a source for the commit message and for what the owner is shown, not a record
why_typed_in_the_open: a delivery's prefix on R2 and its shape are written nowhere this tree can read as data: they sit in comments and prose (tools/TOGGLE-PIPELINE-v1.md, the projectors' headers, the source.ledger strings on receipts), and a candidate with no receipt yet is named nowhere else. So these facts are typed here, each with its source, and 'unknown' is written where the sources name nothing. Anything a receipt or a record can say — which zones carry a layer, what a receipt's rulings_owed says, a source's sha256, a landing date, a byte count, a row count — the driver reads off the receipt (receipt_pins) or the record (record_pins) and never from here; this file keeps the path and the driver reads the number.

fields.id: the queue's name for the delivery; also the folder under build/ledgers/ that --fetch writes
fields.feeds: rail row ids from zone.html's TOGGLES registry (order, masorah, sources, pairs, lookup, maqaf, licence, names, edition); a position inside a row is written row/position (order/witnessed_entry, masorah/only); empty when the delivery reaches the card and not the rail, with feeds_note saying where
fields.r2_prefix: the key prefix inside the bucket, as the sources write it after r2:<bucket>/; 'unknown' when no source names one
fields.delivery_shape: per-position ledger / per-card / sidecar / stream, as the sources say, with the file names; never a count a record carries
fields.objects: the object names the projector reads, with <slug> where there is one per book; empty when nothing is fetched for this entry, and --fetch then refuses the entry by name; objects_note says when the delivery is larger than the names listed
fields.projection_tool: an existing path under tools/, or 'none yet: <what would be needed>'
fields.status: served / candidate / proposed / waiting; --fetch refuses an entry whose status is proposed
fields.landed: where the delivery stands today, in words; every date, size and count it could carry is left to receipt_pins or record_pins and read by the driver
fields.carried_by: how the driver tells that a zone already carries the layer: kind zone_field (a dotted path into the zone's JSON), sidecar (a suffix beside the zone), sidecar_field (a dotted path into that sidecar), store_file or record (one file for every zone), none
fields.ruling_owed: true or false; ruling_receipt_field names the receipt field that carries it as a bare dotted path (which the driver reads off a zone and prints), or says 'none' and where the ruling is stated instead; ruling_what says what is owed
fields.receipt_pins: dotted paths the driver reads off the first zone that has them and prints, so the pin is read, not typed; for a zone_field entry the driver also prints, per zone that carries the layer, counts.verses_held, every counts.verses_absent_from_* and counts.held_examples when the receipt carries them
fields.record_pins: a list of { file, paths }: a record under data/ and dotted paths into it, read and printed by the driver so a date, a size or a count on a record is read here and never typed; a path segment name[key=value] picks the element of an array whose key equals value
fields.next: the entry's own commands, in order, with <slug>, <stamp>, <id> placeholders the driver fills; the shared loop below follows them
fields.guards: the checks for this layer, run by hand from the reader directory with python3 -m http.server 8899 serving it in the background for the browser checks
fields.stop: the line where the owner's ruling is owed and the driver stops
fields.cites: the file:line each value was read at

loop: fetch: node tools/push-toggles-v1.mjs --fetch <id> — the delivery arrives in build/ledgers/<id>.incoming/ and is renamed to build/ledgers/<id>/ only once it holds to its SHA256SUMS (with no sums file: once every object is its listed size, every sha256 printed for the projector's own pin); a refused delivery is deleted with its incoming directory

project, per zone: the entry's own command; the output goes under build/, never over data/zones/<slug>.bin — the in-place writes are named: bake-witnessed-order-v1 (on the zone under build/), project-piece-gloss-v1 (every served zone, never for one), the lattice sidecar data/zones/<slug>.lattice.bin and the volume sidecar data/zones/<slug>.volume.bin, which land beside the zone before the re-pin
regloss: node tools/regloss-zone.mjs --zone <the projected zone under build/> --out data/zones/<slug>.bin --stamp <stamp> — the store re-projected over the zone's keys

re-pin, ONLY after the shelf restore of the runbook's section 2 exited 0 with every pinned bin on disk and exact: node tools/emit-zone-store-v1.mjs ; node tools/emit-zone-shipment-v1.mjs ; node tools/emit-store-manifest-v1.mjs --store data/route-store — emit-zone-store pins what data/zones holds at that moment and nothing else (a bin absent from the disk loses its pin), and emit-zone-shipment refuses PINNED_BUT_ABSENT while any pinned bin is missing; without the restore this step is a stop and the projected zone waits under build/; a zone that changed without a new pin is refused by the reader

guards: the entry's checks, from the reader directory, with python3 -m http.server 8899 --directory . serving it in the background for the browser checks (the runbook's section 2 has the start, the readiness line and the stop)

read: on every re-projected zone, emitted_from.toggles.<name>.rulings_owed and counts.verses_held, counts.verses_absent_from_ledger and counts.held_examples — the projector prints them on stdout (verses ... held, held: ...) and the driver prints them per zone in plan mode (the held: lines); copy them into the report build/toggle-push-report-<stamp>.md, which the operator writes and the driver never does; a held verse is a finding, never re-run or patched for

stop: the TOGGLES entry in zone.html (step 5) and the ruling (step 6) are the owner's; propose the wording in the report (and, for a lab/why, in data/toggle-wording-proposals-v1.json, which the operator may write and the driver never does); write nothing else

after the ruling lands: the owner's dated ruling is written where the projector's receipt carries rulings_owed — the rulings_owed string of tools/project-toggle-<name>-v1.mjs — then re-project, regloss, re-pin (the gate above still holds), and only then the TOGGLES entry in zone.html, which the owner approves
deploy_tail: preconditions: every loop stopped where its entry's stop line says and the report holds every receipt read; when nothing was re-pinned, the gate, the door and the copy are skipped — there is no new bin for the gate to judge or the door to file

the gate: node tools/check-c0-refusals-v1.mjs first (it judges and prints); then --write ONLY IF the shelf restore of the runbook's section 2 exited 0, or a dated ruling of the owner's accepts a receipt cut over the served zones alone; otherwise stop — the door refuses a re-pinned zone whose bytes are not the bytes the gate judged

the door: node tools/plan-build-v1.mjs --out build/build-plan-v1.json --tsv build/build-plan-v1.tsv ; node tools/build-front-door-v1.mjs --zones data/zones --out deploy-root --atlas data/corpus-atlas-v1.json --physical-handoff data/bezelal-front-door-counts-handoff-v1.json --count-bindings data/front-door-three-count-bindings-v1.json
deploy-root to the root: cp -r deploy-root/. .. ; then the byte-identity loop the runbook prints (find + cmp over every file under deploy-root/), which must print no NOT IDENTICAL line
the manifest, the lane state, the ledger index: node tools/pipeline-manifest-v1.mjs --stamp <stamp> ; node tools/emit-lane-state-v1.mjs ; node tools/emit-ledger-index-v1.mjs

the full suite: bash tools/run-all-checks.sh — a red suite deploys nothing; every red row is a known red the runbook names with its reason still holding (S4 before the restore, check-nothing-unlanded-v1 before the push), or a stop
commit: git rev-parse HEAD origin/main first; the list is git status --short, reviewed against the steps run — never a typed list
push: git push origin HEAD:main ; then the suite again — check-nothing-unlanded-v1 green, or the push was incomplete and that is a stop
never: never patch a join by hand: a verse that does not prove is held whole and counted on the receipt (tools/TOGGLE-PIPELINE-v1.md:20-30)

never re-pin a zone that did not change: a pin is read off the bin on disk at emit time and nothing carries an absent bin's pin forward — which is why the re-pin waits for the restored shelf; and never rewrite a zone for no reason
never describe tools/emit-zone-store-v1.mjs as pin-preserving: it pins the directory as it stands when it runs
never touch the Hebrew: no masoretic marking can be removed from the book page (zone.html, the note above MASORAH_KEY); a projection writes beside the word, never in it
never choose a default: the default of every row is the owner's ruling (tools/TOGGLE-PIPELINE-v1.md:124-125); the driver prints positions and chooses none
never mark a row live or record a ruling: a ruling is the owner's, written as a dated record on the receipt's rulings_owed
never write to R2: this lane holds a read token (tools/emit-zone-shipment-v1.mjs:14-16)
never copy a delivery into data/: build/ledgers/ is where it stays
never type what a record can say: this file is the one place a fact is typed in the open, and it says so in its basis; a date, a size or a count a record carries is a record_pin here, not a number

owed_behind_live_rows_not_queued.what: the default at the qere-only and ketiv-only sites (their counts are at tools/TOGGLE-PIPELINE-v1.md:353-354); qere-ketiv-v1.json has what to show; the row runs on the default until the owner rules
